description: Translate the previously-skipped Chinese-only files to PT-BR: the 4 templates/agents-sections/*.md files (test-anchored), .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md, knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-02.md, and knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-03.md. These are the most sensitive files in the pass because the templates contain test-anchored English literals (`Evidence before claims`, `Skill Routing`, `Authority Matrix`, `episodes.md`, `Explore`) and the BEGIN/END HTML markers. Episodes archive files use the pipe-delimited DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS | SUMMARY schema described in translation-rules-cn.md section E.
steps: Edit templates/agents-sections/authority.md: keep `<!-- BEGIN OMK AUTHORITY -->`, `<!-- END OMK AUTHORITY -->`, and `## Authority Matrix` unchanged (test-anchored). Translate the 5 Chinese bullets under `## Authority Matrix` and `## Enforcement` to PT-BR. The text `（hook enforced）` becomes `(hook enforced)` (drop fullwidth parens).

Edit templates/agents-sections/principles.md: keep `<!-- BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES -->`, `<!-- END OMK PRINCIPLES -->`, and `## Principles` unchanged. The literal `Evidence before claims` MUST remain at the start of bullet 1 (test-anchored). Translate every Chinese bracketed gloss to PT-BR keeping the English head term: `Evidence before claims (qualquer declaracao de conclusao precisa de evidencia de verificacao, enforced by stop hook)`, `As code (codifique sempre que possivel ao inves de confiar em texto)`, `TDD driven (desenvolvimento orientado a testes)`, `No hallucination (...)`, `Fail closed (...)`, etc. Convert all Chinese punctuation to ASCII per rules section H.

Edit templates/agents-sections/workflow.md: keep `<!-- BEGIN OMK WORKFLOW -->`, `<!-- END OMK WORKFLOW -->`, `## Workflow`, `## Skill Routing` (test-anchored), `## Knowledge Retrieval`, `Explore` (test-anchored), and `Plan` and `Code` keywords. Translate the prose and table cells to PT-BR. The Phase 0..2 numbered list becomes Portuguese while keeping the English `Phase` keyword and skill names. Translate the `场景 | Skill | 触发方式 | 加载方式` table header to `Cenario | Skill | Como acionar | Como carregar` and translate every cell of the 9 rows. The `Hook 🔎 ...` bullet at the end becomes Portuguese.

Edit templates/agents-sections/self-learning.md: keep `<!-- BEGIN OMK SELF-LEARNING -->`, `<!-- END OMK SELF-LEARNING -->`, `## Self-Learning`, and the literal `episodes.md` (test-anchored). Translate `检测到纠正 → 写入 episodes.md` to `Correcao detectada -> grave em episodes.md`. Translate the second bullet keeping the literal in the backticks unchanged.

Edit .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md: this file is pure prose with technical identifiers. Translate every Chinese sentence to PT-BR. KEEP verbatim: every bracketed identifier list (`search_symbols, find_references, goto_definition, get_hover` etc.), every bullet that quotes an identifier (`pattern_search`, `pattern_rewrite`, `generate_codebase_overview`, `initialize_workspace`, `get_diagnostics`), every code path (`hooks/feedback/...`), every backticked code sample (`def $FUNC($$$):`, `def $FUNC($$$ARGS): $$$BODY`), and the file extensions list (`.py/.ts/.rs`). Translate the explanatory prose around them. Keep `# Code Analysis` heading in English (technical name).

Edit knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-02.md: each line follows `DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS | SUMMARY`. Process line by line. Keep DATE, STATUS (`active`/`resolved`/`promoted`), KEYWORDS verbatim. Translate ONLY the SUMMARY column. Inside the summary, keep verbatim: function names, file names, paths, hook names, identifier names, citation URLs/domains, `①` `②` `③`, emoji, English technical phrases, issue numbers, `DO:`/`DON'T:` markers. Convert Chinese punctuation per rules section H. The 50+ lines run sequentially; do them in 3-4 chunks if helpful. Be careful with strikethrough markdown `~~...~~` - keep the markup, translate the contents.

Verify the test-anchored literals are still present after editing: `grep -q 'Evidence before claims' templates/agents-sections/principles.md`, `grep -q 'Skill Routing' templates/agents-sections/workflow.md`, `grep -q 'Explore' templates/agents-sections/workflow.md`, `grep -q 'Authority Matrix' templates/agents-sections/authority.md`, `grep -q 'episodes.md' templates/agents-sections/self-learning.md`, `grep -q 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' templates/agents-sections/principles.md` and the 3 other BEGIN/END pairs. ALL must exit 0.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 2>&1 | tail -3` and confirm exactly the same line as baseline: `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.
Run pytest and the knowledge harness; counts must match baseline-pytest.txt and baseline-knowledge.txt exactly (60 passed / 8 failed, 1/3).

Confirm none of the 7 edited files contain CJK anymore: `for f in templates/agents-sections/{authority,principles,self-learning,workflow}.md .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-{02,03}.md; do grep -P -l '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' "$f" && echo "STILL CJK: $f"; done` should print nothing.
Stage and commit only those 7 files with message: `docs(i18n): translate previously-skipped CN-only files to pt-BR`. Run `git diff --stat HEAD~1` and verify only those 7 paths appear.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 files have zero CJK characters after editing.

All 9 test-anchored English literals (Coding agent, GTM, Evidence before claims, Skill Routing, Explore, Authority Matrix, episodes.md, plus the 4 BEGIN OMK ... HTML markers) are still present where required.
tests/test-agents-template.sh still reports 27 passed, 1 failed (no regression).

No em dashes added in the touched files: `grep -F -n -- '—' templates/agents-sections/*.md .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-*.md` returns no new occurrences (it may match pre-existing strings inside identifiers).
git diff main HEAD --stat shows only .md files under templates/agents-sections/, .kiro/rules/, knowledge/archive/ (and the prior FEAT-001 plan/baseline files).
verification: Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` - must end with `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.

Run `python3 -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/test_generate_configs.py --ignore=tests/test_debugging_skill.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_pty_runner.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_ralph_loop.py 2>&1 | tail -3` - must contain `8 failed, 60 passed`.
Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10` - must contain `Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total`.

Run `for f in templates/agents-sections/{authority,principles,self-learning,workflow}.md .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-{02,03}.md; do grep -P -c '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' "$f"; done` - all 7 lines must read `0`.

Run `for lit in 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Explore' 'Authority Matrix' 'episodes.md' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' 'BEGIN OMK WORKFLOW' 'BEGIN OMK SELF-LEARNING' 'BEGIN OMK AUTHORITY'; do grep -r -q -F "$lit" templates/agents-sections/ || echo MISSING: $lit; done` - prints nothing.
findings: Translated 7 CN-only files to PT-BR in commit 7651a68 (128 insertions, 123 deletions across 7 files). Files: templates/agents-sections/{authority,principles,self-learning,workflow}.md, .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md, knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-{02,03}.md. All 9 test-anchored literals (Coding agent, GTM, Evidence before claims, Skill Routing, Explore, Authority Matrix, episodes.md, OMK SECTIONS) and the 4 BEGIN/END HTML markers (PRINCIPLES/WORKFLOW/SELF-LEARNING/AUTHORITY) verified present. CJK regex grep on all 7 files returns 0. No em dashes introduced. Verification matched baseline exactly: pytest 8 failed, 60 passed; tests/test-agents-template.sh 27 passed, 1 failed; tests/knowledge/run.sh 1 pass / 3 total. Special handling notes: (a) preserved `(hook enforced)` in authority.md by dropping the fullwidth parentheses to ASCII per rules H. (b) preserved every English head term + translated bracketed gloss in principles.md (e.g. `TDD driven (desenvolvimento orientado a testes)`). (c) preserved English `Phase`, `Skill Routing`, `Explore`, `Plan`, `Code` keywords plus the BEGIN/END markers in workflow.md and translated the 9-row Skill Routing table cells. (d) in code-analysis.md kept every bracketed identifier list, fenced/inline code samples, and file-extension list verbatim while translating the surrounding prose. (e) in episodes archives processed each pipe-delimited row keeping DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS verbatim, translating only SUMMARY; preserved strikethrough markup ~~...~~ (translating its contents), Mandarin code/identifier names verbatim (ralph-loop.sh, AGENTS.md, kiro-cli, etc.), citation URLs (kiro.dev/docs/..., arxiv 2409.00872, kirodotdev/Kiro#NNNN style), `DO:`/`DON'T:` markers, and converted Chinese punctuation (， 。 ； : ？ ！ （ ） 、 ： ⏤) to ASCII equivalents per rules-cn section H. Did NOT use em dashes anywhere; replaced original `——` with `-` plus rephrasing. Line counts preserved per file (episodes-2026-02.md: 56 lines as before; episodes-2026-03.md: 3 lines as before).
